items.title: Abel
items.charge: Bringing the firstlings of his flock and the fat thereof, according to the sacrifice ordained in the garden

items.title: Abigail
items.charge: Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: keeping David from shedding blood and avenging himself with his own hand

items.title: Abraham
items.charge: Obeying the Lord’s voice; keeping his charge, his commandments, his statutes, and his laws

items.title: Ananias of Damascus
items.charge: Going to the street called Straight and putting his hands on the man who had come to bind him: Brother Saul

items.title: Antipas, Smyrna, and Philadelphia
items.charge: Faithful unto death; keeping the word of his patience; not denying his name in the place where Satan’s seat is

items.title: Apollos
items.charge: Being instructed in the way of the Lord, and receiving correction from a tentmaker and his wife

items.title: Asa in his first years
items.charge: Taking away the altars of the strange gods, the high places, the images and the groves; commanding Judah to seek the Lord and to do the law; crying to the Lord against a thousand thousand Ethiopians

items.title: Barak
items.charge: Going down from Tabor at the word of the Lord against nine hundred chariots of iron; and going only on condition that Deborah went

items.title: Barnabas
items.charge: Selling his land and laying the money at the apostles’ feet; a good man, full of the Holy Ghost and of faith

items.title: Baruch the scribe
items.charge: Writing from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the Lord upon a roll, reading it in the house of the Lord and before the princes, and writing it again after the king burned it

items.title: Barzillai the Gileadite
items.charge: Providing the king with sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man

items.title: Bezaleel and Aholiab
items.charge: Making all that the Lord commanded, and no more; and teaching others to do it

items.title: Caleb and Joshua
items.charge: Wholly following the Lord when ten spies and the whole congregation would not

items.title: Cornelius
items.charge: A devout man, one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway

items.title: Daniel
items.charge: Purposing in his heart not to defile himself with the portion of the king’s meat nor with the wine which he drank; kneeling and praying three times a day with his windows open toward Jerusalem, as he did aforetime, after the decree was signed

items.title: David
items.charge: A man after the Lord’s own heart: twice sparing the Lord’s anointed, leaving vengeance with the Lord, and repenting when he fell

items.title: Deborah
items.charge: Judging Israel under the palm tree; delivering the commandment of the Lord to Barak, and going up with him

items.title: Dorcas (Tabitha)
items.charge: Full of good works and almsdeeds which she did; the coats and garments she made for the widows

items.title: Ebed-melech the Ethiopian
items.charge: Going out to the king in the gate of Benjamin and telling him the princes had done evil to Jeremiah, then drawing the prophet up out of the dungeon of mire with old cast clouts and rotten rags under his armholes

items.title: Eldad and Medad
items.charge: Prophesying in the camp when the spirit rested on them, and being defended by Moses

items.title: Eleazar the scribe
items.charge: Choosing to die gloriously rather than eat swine’s flesh, or pretend to, at ninety years old

items.title: Elijah
items.charge: As the Lord God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand: shutting the heaven by prayer, standing alone against eight hundred and fifty at Carmel, and running before the king in the hand of the Lord

items.title: Elisha
items.charge: Leaving the oxen and following; asking a double portion of the spirit; and refusing Naaman’s reward, as the Lord liveth, before whom I stand

items.title: Enoch
items.charge: Walking with God three hundred years

items.title: Epaphroditus
items.charge: For the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me

items.title: Ezra
items.charge: Preparing his heart to seek the law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments; proclaiming a fast at the river Ahava, and being ashamed to ask the king for soldiers after saying the hand of God is upon all them that seek him

items.title: Gaius, the wellbeloved
items.charge: Walking in the truth; doing faithfully to the brethren and to strangers; bringing them forward on their journey after a godly sort

items.title: Gideon
items.charge: Throwing down his father’s altar of Baal; going against Midian with three hundred, as the Lord said

items.title: Hagar, and the God who seeth
items.charge: Returning and submitting when the angel sent her back; and calling him Thou God seest me

items.title: Hannah
items.charge: Pouring out her soul before the Lord, vowing a son to him, and lending him to the Lord as long as he liveth

items.title: Hezekiah
items.charge: Trusting in the Lord God of Israel, so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah; cleaving to him and keeping his commandments; breaking the brasen serpent; opening the doors of the house of the Lord and keeping the passover

items.title: Hosea the prophet
items.charge: Taking a wife of whoredoms at the Lord’s command as a sign against Israel; prophesying the scattering and the return

items.title: Isaac
items.charge: Dwelling in the land the Lord told him of, and not going down into Egypt in the famine

items.title: Isaiah
items.charge: Here am I; send me: a prophet unto a people whose heart was made fat, who walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign, and stood beside the king when Assyria blasphemed

items.title: Israel at the first Passover
items.charge: Doing as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron: the lamb, the blood on the door, the flesh roast with fire, the unleavened bread and bitter herbs

items.title: Ittai the Gittite
items.charge: As the Lord liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be

items.title: Jabez
items.charge: Calling on the God of Israel to bless him indeed, enlarge his coast, keep His hand with him, and keep him from evil

items.title: Jacob at Peniel
items.charge: I will not let thee go, except thou bless me

items.title: Jacob, deceiving Isaac for the blessing
items.charge: Obeying his mother’s voice, who carried the word of the Lord that the elder shall serve the younger; receiving the blessing prophesied before his birth

items.title: Jael
items.charge: Blessed above women in the tent: the nail, the hammer, and Sisera

items.title: Jehoiada the priest
items.charge: Hiding the king’s son in the house of God six years; crowning him with the testimony; making a covenant that they should be the Lord’s people; doing good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house

items.title: Jehoshaphat
items.charge: Walking in the first ways of his father David and seeking not unto Baalim; sending princes and Levites with the book of the law to teach in all the cities of Judah; and setting singers before the army

items.title: Jephthah’s vow
items.charge: A vow uttered before the Lord, and paid in his only daughter

items.title: Jeremiah
items.charge: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; be not afraid of their faces: speaking all that was commanded, though the word was a burning fire shut up in his bones and his own familiars watched for his halting

items.title: Job
items.charge: Perfect and upright, fearing God and eschewing evil; and in all his loss he sinned not with his lips

items.title: Jonadab and the Rechabites
items.charge: Obeying the voice of Jonadab their father in all that he charged them: drinking no wine, building no house, sowing no seed, planting no vineyard, but dwelling in tents all their days

items.title: Jonathan
items.charge: Stripping himself of his robe for the man whom the Lord would make king; standing between his father and David’s innocent blood; thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee

items.title: Joseph
items.charge: Refusing his master’s wife day by day: how can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

items.title: Joseph of Arimathaea
items.charge: Going in boldly unto Pilate and craving the body; and not having consented to the counsel and deed of them

items.title: Joseph, the husband of Mary
items.charge: A just man; doing as the angel of the Lord bade him, four times, without a word recorded

items.title: Josiah
items.charge: A tender heart at the reading of the book; rending his clothes; turning to the Lord with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses

items.title: Jotham
items.charge: Preparing his ways before the Lord his God; doing according to all that his father Uzziah did, howbeit he entered not into the temple of the Lord

items.title: Judas Maccabeus
items.charge: Going to battle with prayer and the law, keeping the ordinances of war, and cleansing the sanctuary

items.title: Judith
items.charge: A widow who feared God greatly, fasting all the days of her widowhood; going out to Holofernes in the name of the Lord

items.title: Lot
items.charge: A just man, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked; pressing the strangers into his house and standing at the door

items.title: Lydia
items.charge: A seller of purple who worshipped God; whose heart the Lord opened; who constrained the apostles to abide in her house

items.title: Manoah and his wife
items.charge: Asking, how shall we order the child? and observing all that the angel commanded

items.title: Mary of Bethany
items.charge: Sitting at his feet to hear his word; anointing his body aforehand to the burying

items.title: Mary, the mother of Jesus
items.charge: Be it unto me according to thy word; blessed is she that believed

items.title: Mattathias
items.charge: Zealous for the law: refusing the king’s commandment at Modin, and executing the apostate on the altar as Phinehas did Zambri

items.title: Mephibosheth
items.charge: What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am? and, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace

items.title: Micaiah the son of Imlah
items.charge: As the Lord liveth, what the Lord saith unto me, that will I speak: against four hundred prophets, two kings, a slap, and a prison

items.title: Mordecai and Esther
items.charge: Mordecai: bowing not to Haman, nor doing him reverence. Esther: gathering the Jews to fast three days, and going in to the king not according to the law: if I perish, I perish

items.title: Moses
items.charge: Refusing to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter; faithful in all the Lord’s house; very meek, above all the men upon the face of the earth

items.title: Naaman the Syrian
items.charge: Going down and dipping himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God, after his anger

items.title: Nehemiah
items.charge: Fasting and praying before the God of heaven for the remnant; building the wall in fifty-two days with a sword in one hand; taking no governor’s bread; forbidding usury; shutting the gates on the Sabbath; remember me, O my God, for good

items.title: Nicodemus
items.charge: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?; and bringing a hundred pound weight of myrrh and aloes

items.title: Noah
items.charge: Doing according to all that God commanded him

items.title: Obadiah, who hid the prophets
items.charge: Taking an hundred prophets and hiding them by fifty in a cave, and feeding them with bread and water, while governor of Ahab’s house

items.title: Obed-edom the Gittite
items.charge: Keeping the ark of God in his house three months, after it had killed Uzzah

items.title: Onesiphorus
items.charge: Oft refreshing Paul, and not ashamed of his chain; seeking him out very diligently in Rome

items.title: Onias the high priest
items.charge: Godliness and hatred of wickedness, so that the laws were kept very well and the city lived in peace

items.title: Othniel and Achsah
items.charge: Taking Kirjath-sepher at Caleb’s word; and asking for the springs as well as the land

items.title: Paul, at the end of his course
items.charge: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith

items.title: Phinehas
items.charge: Zealous for his God at Peor; making an atonement for the children of Israel

items.title: Priscilla and Aquila
items.charge: Laying down their own necks for Paul’s life; and expounding unto Apollos the way of God more perfectly

items.title: Rahab
items.charge: Receiving the spies with peace, and believing that the Lord had given Israel the land

items.title: Rebekah and Abraham’s servant
items.charge: Abraham: making his servant swear to take no wife for Isaac of the daughters of the Canaanites. The servant: asking a sign at the well and worshipping when it came to pass. Rebekah: drawing for the camels, saying, I will go, and covering herself with a vail

items.title: Rizpah
items.charge: Spreading sackcloth upon the rock from the beginning of harvest until water dropped out of heaven, suffering neither the birds by day nor the beasts by night to touch them

items.title: Ruth and Boaz
items.charge: Ruth: cleaving to Naomi and joining herself under Israel and Israel’s God. Boaz: the law of the land conducted at the gate before witnesses, and love thy neighbour as thyself

items.title: Samuel
items.charge: Speak, Lord; for thy servant heareth: telling Eli every whit and hiding nothing; and an accounting no man could contradict, whose ox have I taken?

items.title: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego
items.charge: Not serving the king’s gods nor worshipping the golden image which he had set up; not careful to answer the king in this matter: but if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods

items.title: Shiphrah and Puah, the midwives
items.charge: Fearing God and not doing as the king of Egypt commanded them

items.title: Simeon and Anna
items.charge: Just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel; a widow who departed not from the temple, serving God with fastings and prayers night and day

items.title: Solomon at Gibeon
items.charge: Asking for an understanding heart to judge thy people, and not long life, nor riches, nor the life of his enemies

items.title: Stephen
items.charge: Full of faith and of the Holy Ghost; a face like an angel before the council; forgiving those who stoned him

items.title: Susanna
items.charge: Choosing to fall into the hands of the elders rather than sin in the sight of the Lord

items.title: The Bereans
items.charge: Receiving the word with all readiness of mind, and searching the scriptures daily, whether those things were so

items.title: The Canaanite woman
items.charge: Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table

items.title: The centurion of Capernaum
items.charge: Loving the nation and building the synagogue; not counting himself worthy that the Lord should come under his roof: speak the word only

items.title: The daughters of Zelophehad
items.charge: Asking rightly for their father’s inheritance, and marrying within their tribe as commanded

items.title: The Ephesians who burned their books
items.charge: Confessing and shewing their deeds, and burning fifty thousand pieces of silver worth of curious arts before all men

items.title: The Philippian jailer
items.charge: Believing on the Lord with all his house the same night; washing the stripes of the men he had put in the stocks

items.title: The prophet’s widow, and the pot of oil
items.charge: Borrowing empty vessels of her neighbours, not a few, shutting the door, and pouring, as the prophet said

items.title: The Samaritan leper who returned
items.charge: One of ten: turning back to glorify God with a loud voice, and giving thanks at his feet

items.title: The seven brethren and their mother
items.charge: Refusing to taste swine’s flesh under torture, seven times over, in hope of the resurrection

items.title: The Shunammite woman
items.charge: Constraining the man of God to eat bread, and building him a little chamber on the wall with a bed, a table, a stool, and a candlestick

items.title: The sons of Levi at the golden calf
items.charge: Answering, Who is on the Lord’s side? and executing the sentence on their own brethren

items.title: The widow and her two mites
items.charge: Casting in all that she had, even all her living

items.title: The widow of Zarephath
items.charge: Making the man of God a little cake first, out of the last handful of meal, according to the word

items.title: The woman with the issue of blood
items.charge: Believing that if she might but touch his clothes she should be whole

items.title: Timothy, with Lois and Eunice
items.charge: Unfeigned faith that dwelt first in his grandmother and his mother; knowing the holy scriptures from a child

items.title: Tobit
items.charge: Walking in truth and justice all his days; alms, tithes, and burying the dead of his people at the risk of his own life

items.title: Uriah the Hittite
items.charge: The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; shall I then go into mine house? as thou livest, I will not do this thing

items.title: Zacharias and Elisabeth
items.charge: Both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless

items.title: Zerubbabel and Joshua the high priest
items.charge: Obeying the voice of the Lord their God and the words of Haggai the prophet; humbling themselves, fearing before the Lord, and rising up to work in the house of the Lord of hosts
